Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting user files and demanding Bitcoin ransom
Spreads via SMS messages containing malicious links to victim's entire contact list
Malicious APKs distributed via Reddit and XDA Developers forum posts
Uses QR codes to distribute malicious APKs
Requests multiple Android permissions including SEND_SMS, READ_CONTACTS, INTERNET
Encrypts files with AES and RSA encryption but flawed allowing decryption without paying ransom
App promoted as free sex simulator online game or photo-related app to lure victims
Impacted Systems: Android devices running Android 5.1 or later
Attack Vector: Malicious SMS messages sent to victim's contact list
Malicious posts on Reddit and XDA Developers forums
Malicious APK installation via QR codes and social engineering
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin ransom addresses hardcoded and updated via Pastebin
Ransom note demanding payment between $94 and $188
Exclusion of certain file types and sizes from encryption
Malicious APK samples distributed via Reddit and XDA posts
